Summarise progress towards the WHO End TB milestone path

Source: R/tb_progress.R
tb_progress_summary.Rd

For each country, compares the reduction achieved between 2015 and an assessment year with the reduction the WHO End TB Strategy requires by that year (from tb_required_reduction()).

Usage

tb_progress_summary(
  data = tbprogress::tb_burden,
  indicator = c("incidence", "mortality"),
  assess_year = NULL,
  countries = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with the columns of tb_burden. Defaults to tb_burden.

indicator

Either "incidence" (incidence rate per 100,000) or "mortality" (number of TB deaths).

assess_year

The year to assess. NULL (default) uses the latest year in data.

countries

Optional character vector of country names to keep. NULL (default) keeps all countries.

Value

A tibble with one row per country and columns country, iso3, who_region, population (in the assessment year), indicator, assess_year, baseline_value, current_value, reduction_pct

(positive = burden has fallen), required_reduction_pct, gap_pp

(reduction achieved minus required, in percentage points; positive means ahead of the path) and status (an ordered factor).

Details

Status is assigned as follows:

  • On track: the reduction achieved is at least the required reduction.

  • Behind: the burden has fallen, but by less than required.

  • Rising: the burden is higher than in 2015.

  • No data: the 2015 value (or the value in the assessment year) is missing, or the 2015 value is zero, so a reduction cannot be calculated.

Examples

tb_progress_summary(indicator = "incidence", countries = c("Kenya", "India"))
#> # A tibble: 2 × 12
#>   country iso3  who_region      population indicator assess_year baseline_value
#>   <chr>   <chr> <chr>                <dbl> <chr>           <int>          <dbl>
#> 1 India   IND   South-East Asia 1438069593 incidence        2023            237
#> 2 Kenya   KEN   Africa            55339007 incidence        2023            380
#> # ℹ 5 more variables: current_value <dbl>, reduction_pct <dbl>,
#> #   required_reduction_pct <dbl>, gap_pp <dbl>, status <fct>

# How many countries were on track for deaths in 2023?
s <- tb_progress_summary(indicator = "mortality", assess_year = 2023)
table(s$status)
#> 
#> On track   Behind   Rising  No data 
#>       18      116       67       14
